header.title: Verification page
header.description: Scanning the code on a certificate opens this page. It is hosted on your own portal and needs no login, so anyone holding the certificate can check it.

modeSection.title: What the code opens

page.title: Verification page
page.hint: The hosted page below. Works on any phone, nothing to maintain.

document.title: Your own document
document.hint: Upload a PDF and place dynamic fields on it, like a certificate.

modeSection.fieldsHint: Fields you place are filled in when someone scans — the certificate number, the course, the learner's name as the page shows it. Only the first page becomes the document.
modeSection.uploadHint: Upload the PDF you want people to see. Its first page becomes a canvas you can drop dynamic fields onto, exactly like a certificate.
modeSection.fallbackWarning: Until you upload a document, scans keep opening the verification page below — so verification never breaks while you are still setting this up.

address.label: Address
address.unset: Set your learner portal address in Dashboard → Edit institute profile and this page moves to your own domain. Until then scans verify on the platform address.

customUrl.part1: Scans currently open a link set earlier:
customUrl.part2: . That page receives only the certificate number, which is not a credential, so it cannot prove the certificate is genuine.

headline.label: Headline
headline.hintPart1: The line under the seal. Blank uses “

note.label: Your message (optional)
note.placeholder: e.g. Questions about this certificate? registrar@example.com
note.hint: Shown on the page below. Anyone with the link can read it, so keep it to something public.

detailsList.label: What the page lists
detailsList.hint: The recipient's name (partially masked) and the certificate number are always shown — they are what tie the page to the certificate in someone's hand.
